summary:
Frontend-only end-to-end UI test of the two new Go Perks Admin features: (1) Banner photo upload inside the Email Template editor, and (2) Pitch Results on /admin/prospects showing signed-up counts per pitch version. BOTH FEATURES WORK AS SPECIFIED. All cleanup completed (TEST_ prospect deleted via API, registered TEST_ business user deleted via MongoDB, built-in pitch template reset to original).

=== PART 1: Banner Photo Upload (/admin/emails -> template-item-pitch -> template-layout-banner) ===
- Selecting layout 'banner' reveals template-banner field with template-banner-thumb (default /email/banner.jpg).
- template-banner-upload-btn triggers the hidden template-banner-file input; uploading /app/frontend/public/email/banner.jpg returns a URL under /api/files/go-perks/banners/<user>/<uuid>.jpg.
- Toast 'Photo uploaded. Save to keep it.' appears.
- template-banner-thumb src switches to the uploaded URL.
- template-preview iframe srcdoc contains the uploaded URL (verified by substring match after the 400ms debounce).
- template-banner-clear-btn restores src to '/email/banner.jpg'.
- Non-image file (text/plain) is rejected server-side with toast 'Please upload a PNG, JPG or WebP image' and thumb stays on default.
- Save persists after reload: layout=banner and banner_url still points at /api/files/go-perks/banners/... .
- 'Reset to original' (template-reset-btn, confirm dialog accepted) restores pitch template to defaults; verified via /api/admin/email-templates -> {edited:false, banner_url:'', layout:'classic'} (NO owner templates left edited).

=== PART 2+3: Pitch Results + Signed-up badge ===
- Created TEST_UI prospect 'TEST_UI Pitch Signup <rand>' with suburb Footscray (picked from prospect-suburb-options) and email test_ui_px_<rand>@example.com via prospect-add-btn.
- Row ticked, prospects-bulk-pitch opened pitch-dialog, pitch-send-btn sent the pitch. Polled /api/admin/prospects: pitch_status transitioned queued -> 'sent' within ~2s.
- prospect-pitch-<id> label reads 'Pitch sent'.
- pitch-results section appeared with one card pitch-result-pitch showing: rate 0%, sent 1, signed_up 0, approved 0. All sub-testids present (pitch-result-rate-pitch, pitch-result-sent-pitch, pitch-result-signed-pitch, pitch-result-approved-pitch).
- Registered a business account with the same email via POST /api/auth/register (status 200, created with business_status 'pending').
- Reloaded /admin/prospects: prospect-signed-up-<id> badge is rendered ('SIGNED UP'). The 'Signed up' filter tab (count badge '1') filters to show only that row. pitch-result-signed-pitch increased from 0 -> 1, pitch-result-rate-pitch from 0% -> 100%. /api/admin/prospects/pitch-results confirms [{key:'pitch', sent:1, signed_up:1, approved:0, rate:100}].

=== Responsive (390 x 844 and 1440 x 900) ===
- 1440: layout list + editor + preview as 3 columns (desktop baseline).
- 390: Prospects page stacks headers + Pitch results card above the filter tabs + table, card fills the 358px content column cleanly, no horizontal scroll. Emails page BannerField renders with the four layout tiles in a 2x2 grid, 'Upload photo' and thumb stacked, all visible.

=== Cleanup (verified) ===
- TEST_ prospect deleted (/api/admin/prospects/<id> -> 200).
- Registered TEST_ business user had to be removed via MongoDB (no admin DELETE user endpoint exists -> /api/admin/users/<id> returns 405). users.delete_one -> 1. Final counts: 0 TEST_ prospects remaining, 0 test_ui_px_ users remaining.
- pitch template reset to original (confirmed via API).

minor.issue: DELETE returns 405 Method Not Allowed. There is no admin endpoint to remove a user (even a TEST_ one). Testing agents and admins currently need direct DB access to clean up. Not blocking the two features under review, but worth adding a soft-delete or hard-delete admin endpoint for test/cleanup workflows.

action_items: (optional) Add an admin-only DELETE /api/admin/users/<id> endpoint (or at least a 'cleanup TEST_ accounts' utility) so testing agents can remove TEST_ business accounts without MongoDB access.
critical_code_review_comments: TemplateEditor.BannerField: 5MB client-side guard + server-side mime check (reject toast 'Please upload a PNG, JPG or WebP image') are both present. Good.
BannerField input ref is cleared (e.target.value='') on each upload so re-selecting the same filename still triggers onChange. Good.
Preview debounce (400ms) + srcdoc + sandbox='' on iframe keeps uploaded banner URLs live-reflected. Confirmed working.
PitchResults component correctly returns null when no rows, so no empty card clutters /admin/prospects. Cards render per pitch key with rate/sent/signed_up/approved, all with per-key data-testids.

ProspectsPage FILTERS includes a 'signed' filter using r.signed_up truthiness, which makes the 'Signed up' tab dynamic based on linked partner accounts. Confirmed by the UI count badge going 0 -> 1 after /auth/register with the pitched email.
No admin DELETE /users endpoint means TEST_ business accounts created during test runs can't be cleaned via the UI/API - minor hygiene gap.

BannerField: when layout is switched from 'banner' to another layout, the banner_url is preserved in the form state (good - round-trip-safe); the field is simply hidden by the conditional render. If UX wants it discarded on layout change, add a reset. Acceptable as-is.

success_rate.backend: not tested this iteration (previous iterations green)
success_rate.frontend: 100% - all 9 brief items verified: upload toast, thumb swap, preview iframe reflects URL, clear btn, non-image rejection, save persistence, reset to original, pitch_status=sent, pitch-results card, signed_up badge, Signed-up filter tab, counts/rate update, 390px + 1440px layouts.

seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_ prospect (TEST_UI Pitch Signup <rand>, Footscray 3011, test_ui_px_0kcuhdqg@example.com) - deleted via /api/admin/prospects/<id>. 1 TEST_ business user (same email) - deleted via MongoDB users.delete_one. 1 banner photo uploaded (/api/files/go-perks/banners/<user>/<uuid>.jpg) - still exists on disk but detached from any template (pitch template was reset to original). Baseline (65 seeded prospects) preserved. 0 edited built-in templates remaining, 0 custom templates created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testids verified: template-banner (parent), template-banner-thumb (), template-banner-upload-btn, template-banner-file (hidden input, use set_input_files), template-banner-clear-btn (only rendered when banner_url set). PitchResults testids: pitch-results (section), pitch-result- (card), pitch-result-rate-, pitch-result-sent-, pitch-result-signed-, pitch-result-approved-. ProspectsPage testids used: prospect-signed-up- (badge, only when r.signed_up truthy). Signed-up filter tab is produced by FILTERS[2] in ProspectsPage.jsx, text 'Signed up'. API shortcuts: /api/admin/prospects (list), /api/admin/prospects/pitch-results, DELETE /api/admin/prospects/. Pitch processing is fast (2-3s queued->sent). /api/auth/register returns 200 immediately; linking by email in prospects happens on next GET /admin/prospects. There is NO admin DELETE user endpoint (returns 405) - use MongoDB directly for TEST_ cleanup.
rca of the issue: No defects on either feature. Implementation matches the brief exactly - (a) BannerField in TemplateEditor.jsx uses a hidden file input + POST /admin/email-templates/banner with FormData, 5MB client guard, server MIME validation, correct toasts, and lives inside the existing preview-debounce pipeline so the iframe updates with the new URL. (b) PitchResults.jsx fetches /admin/prospects/pitch-results, renders per-version cards with pitched/signed_up/approved/rate, and the ProspectsPage adds a 'signed' filter + signed-up badge that both flip on when a user account is registered with the same email as a pitched prospect. Backend out/signed_up join is working: 1 pitch sent + 1 /auth/register with that email = rate 100%, signed_up 1.
